description.value: Deer Park Diner is a brunch-focused restaurant on Deer Park Avenue in Kimberley, a small mountain city in BC's East Kootenays. It serves morning and midday meals daily and would make a natural refueling stop for cyclists touring the Kootenay Rockies region. The diner-style format and all-day brunch cuisine are well suited to riders starting or finishing a day on local trails and roads.

address.value: 130 Deer Park Avenue, Kimberley, BC V1A 2J4
